payload.name: ## Goal
payload.description:
Upgrade `02_Data_Structures/` and `03_Algorithms/` legacy folders and populate the empty academic folders `_Curriculum/S02/CSE201_Data_Structures/` and `_Curriculum/S02/CSE202_Algorithms_And_Complexity/` to MIT 6.006/6.046, KTH DD1337/DD2350, TUM IN0007/IN0019, and ETH Zurich academic standard — full rigor (theorem-proof style, recurrence analysis, asymptotic proofs, primary literature anchors), with hybrid parallel/sequential execution.

## Constraints

- **No removals** (D003) — upgrade in place, preserve 5W1H on every file (D014), preserve existing pedagogy standards (Core Teaching Shape, Challenge Block Standard, Constraint-First DSA, contamination-free blocks).
- **No new dependencies** — pure markdown curriculum work; no new tooling required.
- **University anchors use stable URLs** — lecture permalinks (e.g., MIT OCW 6.006 lecture notes PDFs), KTH course-syllabus pages, TUM Moodle/lecture captures.
- **Hybrid execution** (user-selected) — parallel agents for independent variant files, sequential for canonical shared files (INDEX, CONTEXT, audit, decisions).
- **Stale-check coordination** (D011) — every batch ends with `tools/update_context.ps1 -Mode update && check`.
- **Combined Lens ≥ 2.0 avg on every upgraded file** — historical evolution (the weakest dimension at 0–1 across 17/21 folders) is the primary gap to close.
- **Contamination guards** — duplicate answer blocks (two-pointer invariant, binary search trace, fibonacci O(2^N)) must be replaced with local challenges per `00_CONTEXT/CONTAMINATION_GUARDS.md`.
- **Auto-mode execution** — ferment runs in yolo permissions mode for git/file operations, except destructive ops on protected branches.

## Chunks

### Chunk 1 — University Reference Framework (sequential, blocking)

- **Scope**: New file `_Curriculum/S02/UNIVERSITY_REFERENCE_MAP.md` (canonical mapping table: every topic → MIT lecture # + permalink, KTH course code + module, TUM lecture #, ETH course code). Plus 4 sub-files: `MIT_6.046_Topics.md`, `KTH_DD2350_Topics.md`, `TUM_IN0019_Topics.md`, `ETH_Algowiki_Topics.md` — each ~30-50 reference entries with stable permalinks.
- **Depends On**: none
- **Accept When**:
  1. `UNIVERSITY_REFERENCE_MAP.md` exists with ≥ 40 rows covering every CSE201 and CSE202 topic
  2. Every row has stable permalink URL (not `main` HEAD)
  3. Tool: `grep -c 'http' _Curriculum/S02/UNIVERSITY_REFERENCE_MAP.md` ≥ 40
- **Open Questions**:
  - MIT OCW 6.006 has 24 lectures, 6.046 has 23. **Assumption:** map both 6.006 (intro DS/Algo) and 6.046 (advanced algorithms) since CSE201/202 covers the full range. Confirm during execution if user prefers just 6.046.
  - **Assumption:** KTH DD1337 (Algorithms & Data Structures, 7.5 ECTS) for DS basics and DD2350 (Algorithms, Advanced Course) for advanced. Confirm.
  - **Assumption:** TUM IN0007 (Foundations of Algorithms & Data Structures) and IN0019 (Efficient Algorithms & Data Structures). Confirm.

### Chunk 2 — Populate CSE201_Data_Structures (parallel batches, 4 subagents)

- **Scope**: Build full academic content for `_Curriculum/S02/CSE201_Data_Structures/`. Currently only `README.md` exists. Files to create (parallel_group: 1, run concurrently):
  - **Batch A — Foundations**: `01_Mathematical_Foundations.md` (sets, functions, relations, induction, proofs), `02_Asymptotic_Notation.md` (formal O/Ω/Θ/o/ω with limit definitions, MIT 6.046 Lec 1-2 anchor), `03_Recurrence_Relations.md` (Master Theorem proof, Akra-Bazzi intro, CLRS Ch 4), `04_Arrays_DynamicArrays.md` (formal array ADT, amortized analysis via accounting method)
  - **Batch B — Linear Structures**: `05_LinkedLists.md` (formal singly/doubly/circular with invariants), `06_Stacks_Queues_Deques.md` (ADT specification + amortized), `07_HashTables.md` (universal hashing proof, MIT 6.006 Lec 8)
  - **Batch C — Trees**: `08_BinaryTrees_Traversals.md`, `09_BST_AVL.md` (with rotation proofs), `10_RedBlack_Trees.md` (5 invariants + insert/delete proofs, MIT 6.046 Lec 4), `11_B_Trees.md` (disk-aware, MIT 6.046 Lec 11)
  - **Batch D — Heaps, Tries, Graphs**: `12_Heaps_PriorityQueues.md` (heap property proof), `13_Tries_SuffixTrees.md`, `14_Graph_Representations.md`, `15_Disjoint_Sets_UnionFind.md` (with inverse-Ackermann proof, MIT 6.046 Lec 6)
- **Depends On**: Chunk 1
- **Accept When**:
  1. 14 new files exist in `S02/CSE201_Data_Structures/`
  2. Every file has: 5W1H block (preserved/added), formal theorem statement with proof sketch, MIT/KTH/TUM anchor permalink, local challenge with answer block, recurrence/complexity table
  3. Tool: `grep -lE '^## 5W1H|^### 5W1H|5W1H —' _Curriculum/S02/CSE201_Data_Structures/*.md | wc -l` = 14
- **Open Questions**:
  - **Assumption:** each lecture-style file ~400-800 lines (matches existing legacy file sizes). Confirm if more condensed/longer preferred.

### Chunk 3 — Populate CSE202_Algorithms_And_Complexity (parallel batches, 4 subagents)

- **Scope**: Build full academic content for `_Curriculum/S02/CSE202_Algorithms_And_Complexity/`. Currently only `README.md`. Files (parallel_group: 1):
  - **Batch A — Paradigms**: `01_Divide_And_Conquer.md` (Master Theorem application, MIT 6.046 Lec 2-3), `02_Greedy_Algorithms.md` (exchange argument proofs, matroid theory intro), `03_Dynamic_Programming.md` (Bellman 1957, optimal substructure proofs, MIT 6.046 Lec 9-11)
  - **Batch B — Graph Algorithms**: `04_Graph_Traversals.md` (BFS/DFS with full correctness proofs), `05_Shortest_Paths.md` (Dijkstra 1959, Bellman-Ford 1958, Floyd-Warshall 1962 — full proofs), `06_Minimum_Spanning_Trees.md` (Prim 1957, Kruskal 1956, cut property proof)
  - **Batch C — Advanced Topics**: `07_Network_Flow.md` (Ford-Fulkerson, Edmonds-Karp, MIT 6.046 Lec 14-15), `08_NP_Completeness.md` (Cook 1971, Karp 21, polynomial reduction), `09_Approximation_Algorithms.md` (PTAS, FPTAS), `10_Randomized_Algorithms.md` (Las Vegas/Monte Carlo, fingerprinting)
  - **Batch D — Specialized**: `11_String_Algorithms.md` (KMP 1977, suffix arrays, MIT 6.046 Lec 19), `12_Computational_Geometry.md` (sweep line, Voronoi intro), `13_Parallel_Algorithms.md` (PRAM model intro, MIT 6.046 Lec 25-26)
- **Depends On**: Chunk 1
- **Accept When**:
  1. 13 new files exist in `S02/CSE202_Algorithms_And_Complexity/`
  2. Every file: 5W1H, formal theorem + proof, named inventor + year (fixes weakest HE dimension), anchor permalink, local challenge
  3. Tool: `grep -lE '5W1H' _Curriculum/S02/CSE202_Algorithms_And_Complexity/*.md | wc -l` = 13
- **Open Questions**: same lecture-length assumption as Chunk 2

### Chunk 4 — Upgrade 03_Algorithms/ flagged files (batched by topic, 5 subagents)

- **Scope**: Upgrade the 35 P2-flagged files per `03_ALGORITHMS_AUDIT_P2_UPGRADE_LIST.md`. Files grouped by topic (parallel_group: 1):
  - **Sub-batch 4A — Sorting/Recursion** (sequential within batch, 6 files): `02a_Sorting_Fundamentals.md`, `02b_Sorting_Advanced.md`, `02c_Divide_And_Conquer.md`, `03b_Recursion_Fundamentals.md`, `03c_Recursion_Advanced.md`, `06c_Advanced_Algo_Deep.md`
  - **Sub-batch 4B — DP/Greedy** (5 files): `04b_DP_Fundamentals.md`, `04c_DP_Advanced.md`, `11_Backtracking_Complete.md`, `12_Greedy_Algorithms_Complete.md`, `16_DSA_Deep_Reasoning.md`
  - **Sub-batch 4C — Graphs** (4 files): `05_Trees.md`, `05b_Graphs_Internals.md`, `05c_Graphs_Fundamentals.md`, `05d_Graphs_Advanced_Algos.md`, `05e_Graphs_Patterns.md`
  - **Sub-batch 4D — Strings/Number Theory** (5 files): `06_Math_Geometry_Java_Complete.md`, `06d_String_Algorithms.md`, `08a_NumberTheory_Core.md`, `08b_NumberTheory_Advanced.md`, `13_String_Algorithms_Complete.md`
  - **Sub-batch 4E — Advanced/Patterns** (8 files): `06e_Algorithm_Patterns.md`, `07a_Advanced_DS_Core.md`, `07b_Advanced_DS_Patterns.md`, `07d_Probabilistic_DS_Deep.md`, `07e_Advanced_Algorithm_Engineering_Deep.md`, `17_DSA_Java_Implementation_Mastery.md`, `18_Bitwise_Trie_Java_Complete.md`, `19_Prefix_Sum_Prefix_XOR_2D_Prefix_Java_Complete.md`, `20_DSA_Patterns_PDF_Java_Coverage_Map.md`, `03_PROBLEM_SETS.md`, `09_Pattern_Programs_Complete.md`, `10_Bit_Manipulation_Complete.md`
  - **Plus canonical shared files** (SEQUENTIAL after all sub-batches): `00_INDEX.md`, `CONTEXT.md` — update with new academic references and Combined Lens scores.
- **Depends On**: Chunk 1 (uses `UNIVERSITY_REFERENCE_MAP.md` for anchors)
- **Accept When**:
  1. All 35 flagged files have: (a) University Anchor section with stable permalink, (b) named inventor + year (e.g., "Dijkstra 1959", "Huffman 1952", "Hoare 1959", "Knuth-Morris-Pratt 1977"), (c) local-only challenge block (no duplicates), (d) Combined Lens avg ≥ 2.0
  2. Tool: `python tools/pedagogy_lens.py 03_Algorithms/*.md` (or equivalent grep-based check) reports no file with avg < 2.0
  3. `00_INDEX.md` updated with academic mapping table
  4. `CONTEXT.md` references new anchor sources
- **Open Questions**: none (scope is well-defined by existing audit)

### Chunk 5 — Upgrade 02_Data_Structures/ (light touch, 1 subagent)

- **Scope**: Apply lighter upgrade to the 14 DS files (already avg 2.4 per audit). Focus on:
  - Add University Anchor section (MIT 6.006 lecture permalink) to each file
  - Strengthen Historical Evolution (HE=2 currently → target HE=3) — add named inventors/years where missing
  - Consolidate duplicate answer blocks per contamination guards
  - Files: `01a_Memory_Foundations.md`, `01b_Arrays.md`, `01c_LinkedList.md`, `01d_Stack_Queue.md`, `01e_HashTable.md`, `01f_Trees_Heaps.md`, `01g_DS_Internals.md`, `02a_DS_Variants_Core.md`, `02b_DS_Variants_Advanced.md`, `03_Collections_Java.md`, `04_2D_Arrays_Matrix.md`, `05_DS_In_Production.md`
- **Depends On**: Chunk 1, Chunk 4 (consistent anchor style)
- **Accept When**:
  1. All 14 DS files have a `## University Anchor` section with stable MIT/KTH/TUM permalink
  2. Combined Lens score raises from 2.4 → ≥ 2.6
  3. Tool: `grep -lE 'University Anchor' 02_Data_Structures/*.md | wc -l` = 14
- **Open Questions**: none

### Chunk 6 — Cross-linking & registry update (sequential, final)

- **Scope**:
  - Update `_Curriculum/S01/.../_Curriculum_Map.md` and `_Curriculum/S02/.../README.md` files with new file lists
  - Update `00_CURRICULUM/CURRICULUM_OVERVIEW.md` references
  - Update `00_CURRICULUM/SEMESTER_1_GUIDE.md` and `SEMESTER_2_GUIDE.md` "Read" column with new academic-folder paths
  - Update `00_CONTEXT/FILE_REGISTRY.md` (auto-generated) and `REPO_MAP.md`
  - Update `00_CONTEXT/CONTAMINATION_GUARDS.md` with any new contamination patterns discovered
  - Update `00_CONTEXT/PEDAGOGY_AUDIT_2026.md` with post-upgrade scores
  - Update `00_CONTEXT/CHANGE_JOURNAL.md` with chunk-by-changelog
- **Depends On**: Chunks 2, 3, 4, 5
- **Accept When**:
  1. `SEMESTER_1_GUIDE.md` "Read" column references new CSE201 files where appropriate
  2. `SEMESTER_2_GUIDE.md` "Read" column references new CSE202 files
  3. `FILE_REGISTRY.md` regenerated and contains all new file paths
  4. `tools/update_context.ps1 -Mode check` returns 0 stale files
  5. Final overall Combined Lens avg for `03_Algorithms` ≥ 2.0, for `02_Data_Structures` ≥ 2.6
- **Open Questions**: none

### Chunk 7 — Verification gate (sequential, mandatory)

- **Scope**: Run the verification-before-completion skill. Confirm:
  - All files exist on disk (paths verified via `ls`)
  - Every upgraded file passes the Combined Lens rubric (avg ≥ 2.0)
  - 5W1H preserved on every file (D014 verification: `grep -l '5W1H' <folder>/*.md | wc -l` matches `.md` count)
  - No duplicate `<details>` answer blocks remain (contamination guard check)
  - Stale-check passes
- **Depends On**: Chunk 6
- **Accept When**:
  1. All verification commands return exit 0
  2. Summary report generated at `.kimchi/docs/ferment-ds-algo-upgrade-summary.md` listing: file count, score deltas, anchor sources used, contamination patterns resolved
- **Open Questions**: none

## Verification Strategy

| Check | Command | Pass Criterion |
|-------|---------|----------------|
| 5W1H preserved | `grep -lE '5W1H' <folder>/*.md \| wc -l` | equals `.md` count in folder |
| Anchor presence | `grep -lE 'University Anchor\|MIT 6\|KTH DD\|TUM IN\|ETH' <folder>/*.md \| wc -l` | equals number of upgraded files |
| Combined Lens avg | `tools/pedagogy_lens.py <folder>/*.md` (or manual score) | no file < 2.0 |
| Duplicate answer blocks | `grep -c 'Answer</summary>' <file>` per file | ≤ 1 per challenge |
| Stale context | `tools/update_context.ps1 -Mode check` | exit 0 |
| File existence | `ls -1 <expected_files>` | all present |

## Decision Log

| ID | Decision | Rationale | Rejected Alternatives |
|----|----------|-----------|----------------------|
| DL-01 | Use MIT 6.006 + 6.046 (both), not just 6.046 | CSE201 covers intro DS (6.006 territory), CSE202 covers advanced (6.046 territory) | Just 6.046 alone — misses intro DS framing |
| DL-02 | Academic anchors use `pdf` permalinks from MIT OCW, KTH Canvas, TUM Moodle | Stable URLs that survive course updates | HEAD/main URLs — rot in weeks (D012) |
| DL-03 | Parallel agents on independent variant files; sequential on canonical INDEX/CONTEXT/audit | Reduces contamination risk on shared files | Full parallel — risks parallel-agent conflicts (D011) |
| DL-04 | Skip EXAM_BANK.md expansion (user didn't select it) | Scope discipline | Include — would inflate ferment scope |
| DL-05 | Light touch on `02_Data_Structures/` (already avg 2.4) | Already passes threshold; effort better spent on weak files | Heavy rewrite — would discard high-quality existing content |
| DL-06 | New academic content lives in `_Curriculum/S02/CSE201/` & `CSE202/`; legacy folders stay | Matches dual-track convention: practical (legacy) + academic (curriculum) | Merge into one — would create one giant folder |
| DL-07 | Use CLRS + Sedgewick as primary text references; MIT/KTH/TUM as anchor | CLRS is the canonical CS algo text; Sedgewick is KTH's required text | Pure university anchors only — less portable |

## Risks

| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
|------|------------|------------|
| **Subagent stale conflicts** when two agents edit the same canonical file (e.g., both touch `_Curriculum/S02/.../README.md`) | Medium | Stale-check before each batch; only one subagent owns each file path; canonical files (INDEX/CONTEXT) handled sequentially in Chunk 6 |
| **Anchor URLs rot** after publication | Medium | Use stable permalinks (PDFs, archived lecture notes, course-syllabus pages), not lecture-recording streams |
| **Scope creep** into other folders (e.g., 04_Patterns_Templates, 07_Modern_Java) | Medium | Hard boundary: only touch `02_Data_Structures/`, `03_Algorithms/`, `_Curriculum/S02/CSE201/`, `_Curriculum/S02/CSE202/`, and registry updates in Chunk 6 |
| **Token budget** — 40+ new files × ~600 lines + 35 file upgrades | High | Use parallel agents to parallelize; defer chunk 4/5 long-tail files if budget tightens |
| **Existing contamination patterns** (duplicate answer blocks) may be re-introduced | Medium | Each subagent prompt includes the contamination-guard list explicitly |
| **5W1H removal** during upgrade | Low | Explicit per-subagent instruction + post-batch grep verification |
| **MIT 6.046 vs 6.006 confusion** | Low | Each anchor explicitly names which course + lecture # |
| **Heavily-flagged files in 03_Algorithms** (some at avg 1.0) need more than surface fix | Medium | Mark these (`03_PROBLEM_SETS.md`, `06d_String_Algorithms.md`, `09_Pattern_Programs_Complete.md`, `10_Bit_Manipulation_Complete.md`) for deeper rewrite rather than incremental patch |

## Estimated Effort

- Chunk 1: 1 subagent, ~30 min
- Chunk 2: 4 parallel subagents, ~90 min wall-clock (longest subagent ~75 min)
- Chunk 3: 4 parallel subagents, ~90 min wall-clock
- Chunk 4: 5 parallel subagents, ~120 min wall-clock (longest subagent ~100 min for 12 files)
- Chunk 5: 1 subagent, ~45 min
- Chunk 6: 1 subagent (sequential), ~30 min
- Chunk 7: 1 verification agent, ~15 min
- **Total wall-clock**: ~7 hours with parallelism (vs ~14 hours sequential)
- **Total subagent count**: ~16 subagent invocations

## Assumptions Made (require user confirmation before execution)

1. **MIT course coverage**: Mapping uses both 6.006 (intro DS/Algo) and 6.046 (advanced algorithms) — covers full CSE201/202 range. Alternative: just 6.046.
2. **KTH course codes**: DD1337 (intro, 7.5 ECTS) and DD2350 (advanced, 7.5 ECTS). Alternative: DD1351, DD2440.
3. **TUM course codes**: IN0007 (Foundations of Algorithms & Data Structures) and IN0019 (Efficient Algorithms & Data Structures). Alternative: IN0001, IN0002.
4. **ETH course**: References informal Algowiki and 252-0026/252-0057 lecture notes since ETH doesn't have a single canonical Algo course.
5. **Lecture-note file length**: ~400-800 lines per file (matches existing legacy folder sizes).
6. **EXAM_BANK expansion is OUT of scope** (user didn't select it).
7. **Tools script `tools/update_context.ps1` already exists** and works (assumption from existing audit files referring to it).

phaseSnapshots.name: Foundations Upgrade 01a-01f
phaseSnapshots.goal: Bring memory foundations and the 5 core data structures (01a Memory, 01b Arrays, 01c LinkedList, 01d Stack/Queue, 01e HashTable, 01f Trees/Heaps) to university-level rigor.
phaseSnapshots.description: Per file: (a) 5W1H preserved at top; (b) formal complexity analysis (Big-O with justification, not just notation); (c) brute-force baseline present; (d) constraint signals section; (e) when-this-DS-breaks section; (f) invariants section where structurally relevant (01c, 01e, 01f); (g) edge cases list. University-grade means: a CS student could use the file to prepare for an exam.

steps.description: Upgrade `01a_Memory_Foundations.md` — formal memory cost model (Big-O of allocation/copy/access), reference vs value semantics, DS-layout tradeoffs (cache locality, pointer chasing)
Upgrade `01b_Arrays.md` — constraint signals (size, random access, contiguous memory), when-arrays-break (resize cost, fragmentation), brute-force baseline, edge cases (empty, single element)
Upgrade `01c_LinkedList.md` — invariants (prev/next integrity, head/tail sentinels), when-LL-breaks (cache misses, random access cost), pointer pitfalls edge cases (cycles, lost references)
Upgrade `01d_Stack_Queue.md` — constraint signals, when-LIFO/FIFO-breaks (bounded vs unbounded, recursion depth), recursion-to-iterative conversion pitfalls
Upgrade `01e_HashTable.md` — invariants (load factor threshold, hash uniformity, rehashing trigger), collision-driven failure modes, when-HashMap-breaks (pathological keys, resize cost)
Upgrade `01f_Trees_Heaps.md` — invariants (BST ordering, heap property, AVL balance factor), rebalancing cost, when-trees-break (skewed BST, degenerate heap operations)
Run `python3 tools/update_context.py check` and log to CHANGE_JOURNAL.md

For `02b_DS_Variants_Advanced.md` (skip list, bloom, trie) — invariants, sizing formulas (Bloom false-positive rate, skip list level probability), when-variant-breaks.
